scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.7] — "Any other unescaped `{` or `}` not forming a valid site is a compile error", exercised. `{t.a + t.b}` is a brace pair whose body is an operator expression: not a slot path and not a one-level call, so not a valid interpolation site. Reject-don't-skip matters here more than usual — the alternative is not a crash but silent literal text, so the log line would ship the characters `{t.a + t.b}` to an operator who asked for a value. Asserts DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_PATH specifically: `{{`/`}}` escaping is sentinel-substituted before this check, so a compiler that mishandled the escapes would also fail here, and only the code distinguishes the two causes.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log critical "total {t.a + t.b}"
